message.content: On April 10th, 2026, WolfgangSchulz suggested a new song called "Stand By Me" by a classic band, though the name of the band isn't specified in the conversation. LiHua agreed enthusiastically and proposed to try playing it during their jam session on Sunday. YurikoYamamoto was also excited about the idea, noting its nice rhythm and suggesting they could all join in. The group decided to explore the song, and WolfgangSchulz expressed his anticipation for seeing how the new tool could assist them with their drumming practice. LiHua added that they could mix things up by giving the arrangement a twist, emphasizing the importance of creativity in their sessions. Thus, "Stand By Me" became a new song they planned to work on during their upcoming jam session.
